issues: 56px 小字词在 1080p 画面正中只占一小块，几何是 1px 暗灰细线，暂停任意一帧都像空场
#07080c 平底加 20 颗同样大小的白点，没有光、没有层次，三段之间也没有把它们缝起来的版式元素
三套几何各自只做了「出现」：虚线圆匀速转、三圆长完就停，读不出快 / 好的论证
结论词 Stronger 的 sheen 是灰色渐变，扫光前后整字发灰，金属感和收白的落点都不够
changes: look 换成 graphite 石墨暗场电影字卡：词放大到 230px/800 静态字库，几何放大到画幅级（虚线环 r=400、三圆 r=218），词下 40px 副句给产品证据，左上「01 / 03」计数 + 底部三段进度条把三拍缝成一个连续段落
Faster：虚线环 0.4→1 snappy 生长时多转 160° 减速刹住，外圈 120 格刻度环反向慢转，一道渐隐彗星弧以 7.5°/帧沿环飞跑——快由转速差读出
词表改为 Faster / Tighter / Stronger；Tighter 的三圆 trim 依次生长后间距 340→300 收拢咬紧，落定瞬间圆线提亮、四个相交点弹出菱形铆钉光点
Stronger：竖向镀铬渐变底 + 带香槟暖色的窄白带扫过，再收纯白并一次泛光脉冲，脚下横向光带展开、舞台主光同拍提亮；收白后 hold 22f
时间表按帧重排：入场 14f snappy（1.06→1 去虚）、出场 10f exit（0.86 + 12px 退焦）、交接重叠 6f；相机全程 1→1.025 极缓推进；修掉 mask/background-clip 裁掉 g 下伸部露出描边的问题
issuesEn: The 56px words occupied a tiny patch at the center of a 1080p frame and the geometry was 1px dark-grey hairlines, so any paused frame looked empty
A flat #07080c ground with 20 identical white dots had no light and no depth, and nothing in the layout stitched the three beats together
Each geometry only 'appeared': the dashed ring spun at a constant rate and the three circles just stopped once drawn, so they never argued for fast or better
The concluding word's sheen was a grey gradient, so Stronger looked grey before and after the sweep and neither the metal nor the whiteout landed
changesEn: Switched to the graphite look as a cinematic title card: words scaled to 230px/800 in a static face, geometry scaled to frame size (dashed ring r=400, circles r=218), a 40px proof line under each word, plus a '01 / 03' counter and a three-segment progress rail that stitch the beats into one passage

Faster: the dashed ring grows 0.4→1 with a snappy ease while over-spinning 160° and braking like a flywheel, an outer 120-tick ring counter-rotates, and a fading comet arc races around at 7.5°/frame so speed reads from the difference in rates

Word list is now Faster / Tighter / Stronger; Tighter's three circles trim on in sequence, then close their spacing 340→300 to lock together, brightening on contact while four diamond rivet glints pop at the intersections

Stronger: a vertical chrome gradient with a narrow champagne-tinted white band sweeping across, then a whiteout with one bloom pulse, a horizontal light line unfurling underneath and the key light lifting on the same beat; 22f hold after the whiteout

Retimed in frames: 14f snappy entries (1.06→1 sharpening), 10f ease-in exits (0.86 with 12px defocus), 6f handoff overlaps; the camera pushes 1→1.025 very slowly throughout; fixed mask/background-clip cropping the g descender and exposing the outline layer
